title: prospective cross-initialization C2-to-C4 formation dynamics
status: three untouched initializations; milestones, panels, thresholds, and outcomes frozen before training
hypothesis: The seed1879 two-stage pattern is not unique: during fresh C4 training, an L2-core causal precursor will appear before the fully qualified L2-core/L3-support 16-chunk route in at least two of three untouched initializations.
seed_provenance: No checkpoint or prior model state is reused; every formal seed starts from a new model initialization.

training_protocol.C4_saved_milestones: C2 endpoint as step0, then C4 step1 and every 100 validation step through the registered stop
training_protocol.training_stop: stop C4 at the original two-consecutive behavior gate or at step1500; never continue to C8, C16, or Probe withdrawal

registered_thresholds.formed_behavior: intact query >=0.90 and minimum local accuracy across conditions >=0.90
registered_thresholds.whole_memory_causal: formed behavior and reset-all, zero-all, and batch-roll-all query <=0.20
registered_thresholds.layer_necessary_or_roll_sensitive: the corresponding zero or batch-roll query <=0.20
registered_thresholds.L2_core: whole-Memory causal; zero-L2 and roll-L2 <=0.20; keep-L2 >=0.80; zero-L3 >=0.80; keep-L3 <=0.20; keep-L2-L3 >=0.90
registered_thresholds.L3_support: keep-L2-L3 minus keep-L2 >=0.03 and intact minus roll-L3 >=0.05
registered_thresholds.L2_causal_precursor: not yet the full L2-core/L3-support target; intact >=0.75; minimum local >=0.90; all whole-Memory controls <=0.20; zero-L2 and roll-L2 <=0.20; keep-L2 >=0.70; zero-L3 >=0.70; keep-L3 <=0.20; keep-L2-L3 >=0.75; pair gain >=0.03; roll-L3 drop >=0.05

per_seed_registered_outcomes.l2_two_stage_replication_within_C4: an L2 causal precursor first appears after C2 step0, a later milestone reaches the target route, and target membership never regresses through the C4 endpoint
per_seed_registered_outcomes.l2_precursor_present_at_C2_then_target_b: the precursor already exists at the C2 endpoint and the C4 endpoint reaches target
per_seed_registered_outcomes.l2_target_without_registered_precursor: the C4 endpoint is target but no earlier registered precursor milestone exists
per_seed_registered_outcomes.l2_target_present_at_C2_endpoint: the full target route is already present before C4 training
per_seed_registered_outcomes.l2_target_recovered_after_regression: the target route occurs, regresses at a later saved milestone, and returns by the C4 endpoint
per_seed_registered_outcomes.l2_target_regressed_before_C4_endpoint: a target milestone occurs but the C4 endpoint is not target
per_seed_registered_outcomes.l2_precursor_without_target: one or more precursor milestones occur but no target milestone occurs
per_seed_registered_outcomes.alternative_formed_causal_route: formed whole-Memory-causal behavior occurs without the registered L2 target route
per_seed_registered_outcomes.no_registered_16chunk_formation: neither a causal precursor nor formed whole-Memory-causal 16-chunk behavior occurs
per_seed_registered_outcomes.training_prerequisite_failed: the fixed or C2 prerequisite fails within its locked budget

cohort_registered_classification.strong_prospective_two_stage_replication: at least two of three seeds satisfy l2_two_stage_replication_within_C4
cohort_registered_classification.conditional_prospective_two_stage_replic: exactly one of three seeds satisfies l2_two_stage_replication_within_C4
cohort_registered_classification.L2_formation_without_two_stage_replicati: no seed satisfies within-C4 two-stage replication, but at least one seed reaches the L2 target by its C4 endpoint
cohort_registered_classification.alternative_route_formation_observed: no seed reaches the L2 target endpoint, but at least one seed forms whole-Memory-causal 16-chunk behavior through another layer signature
cohort_registered_classification.prospective_formation_dynamics_not_repli: no seed forms registered whole-Memory-causal 16-chunk behavior by its C4 endpoint

secondary_outputs: first precursor and first target step per seed
full L1/L2/L3 necessity, roll-sensitivity, single-layer sufficiency, and pair-sufficiency signatures
C4 in-range validation versus fresh 16-chunk behavior
model parameter displacement from each seed's C2 endpoint
scope: This is a prospective three-seed replication of early C2-to-C4 formation dynamics on the synthetic marked-retrieval task. It tests whether the seed1879 sequence generalizes; it does not estimate population-level success precisely or establish language-model performance.
stop_rule: Report the fixed three-seed cohort classification. Do not rescue, replace, extend, or selectively continue a seed after viewing its trajectory.
